desc: The endless Glitz Pit from round 6 ($TTYD_MODE_STEP), the auto-battler with god mode: its enemies at 150% HP by the mode's own scaling while the player's difficulty settings stay as they were (it wrote them, and any settings save kept them), and off again at its end

\[modes\] the Pit's scaling off: the player's own difficulty again \(difficulty 0\)
